music.instruments: muted piano, low strings, minimal texture - never vocals

narrator_persona.name: Sessiz Rehber (Silent Guide)
narrator_persona.voice_tone: Never monotone - lowers and slows for reflective passages, lightly emphasizes surprising ideas. Uses strategic pauses to let a thought land.
narrator_persona.word_choice: Simple and striking, not academic/ornate. Every paragraph ends on a question that pulls the viewer forward.
narrator_persona.viewer_contract: Speaks as an insider sharing privileged perspective, humbly rather than as absolute authority. Uses 'we/together' language.
narrator_persona.context_discipline: Never breaks the piece for unrelated tangents. Closes whatever loop the opening opened. Follows a worldview-shaking claim with a 'safe exit' line so the viewer doesn't leave defensive.

content_rules.source: user-supplied analysis of 'Nida Yıldırım' - Boutique Intellectual strategy, not Claude-authored - preserved here per Module 21's structural-only boundary (bible/Module_21_Channel_Format_Intelligence.md §2), which cannot hold prose rules like these
rules: K1 Curation over chronology: draw from thinkers and ideas (Lao Tzu, Simone Weil) rather than events. Package information as a life philosophy/mental tool, not a fact to memorize.
K2 Authority aesthetic: clean, bright, 'study/intellectual library' visual language - the opposite of a dark mystery aesthetic. Reads as calm/lucid, not conspiratorial.
K3 Personal-transformation hook: open on the viewer's actual problem (exhaustion, meaninglessness, searching) with an imperative call to action, not a mystery question.
K4 Slow content discipline: deliberately resist fast-paced algorithm bait. Go deep, don't rush - trades faster growth for audience loyalty and retention.

K5 Personal brand trust: the presenter's own perspective is the product ('you could find the facts on Google, but you want to hear it through my lens') - never separate the presenter's stance from the information.

K6 Mental-tool packaging (added 2026-08-08, 50-madde source Bölüm 3): information is never delivered as an isolated 'hap bilgi' (info-pill) - it's packaged as a portable 'zihinsel araç' (mental tool) the viewer can apply to their own life, and every idea is grounded in a named thinker/text, not left floating.

K7 Anti-jump-cut discipline (added 2026-08-08, Bölüm 4): explicit rejection of YouTube-algorithm jump-cut/dopamine-chasing editing rhythm - a topic stays on screen long enough to be worked through fully rather than sliced for retention tricks.

K8 Measured safe-exit (added 2026-08-08, Bölüm 8): after surfacing a hard truth, the format humanizes the cited thinkers via their own real flaws/struggles and frames the viewer's dissatisfaction as a normal structural part of being human - NOT as a pathology, but also notably NOT as evidence the viewer's response is superior/more rational than others' (contrast with CFP-0004/Portal's stronger nihilism-as-therapy framing, which this template deliberately does not adopt).

hybrid_model_note.source: user-supplied 'İki Formatlı Strateji Matrisi' (doc15) describing how one channel runs both TPL-mystery-discovery (Format A: Keşif) and TPL-boutique-intellectual (Format B: Derinleşme) together
rules: Consistency: intro music, color palette, and sound design stay identical across both formats so the channel is recognizable regardless of which format a given video uses - the narrator's voice never changes, only the pacing/visual register does.
Bridge strategy: Format A videos end with a soft transition line into a Format B topic, psychologically preparing the viewer for the shift.
Tribe framing: rally viewers around the presenter's point of view, not the topic - so both formats reinforce the same audience relationship instead of splitting it.
Algorithmic balance: Format A (3x/month) is the 'brochure' that pulls in traffic via the algorithm; Format B (1x/month) is the 'proof of quality' that converts viewers into loyal subscribers.

editorial_note: Not applied to any existing project in this repo. Selecting this template for a specific project is a creative/editorial decision outside Technical Production Director authority (CLAUDE.md §3) and needs an explicit human choice.
